## Notice of Violation MNDA-VN-2026-01352
**Marsa Al Noor Development Authority — Field Operations & Inspection Department**

- **Inspection reference:** MNDA-INS-2026-06811 — 18 September 2026 at 09:10
- **Plot:** MN-04-109-0062 · **Building permit:** MNDA-BP-2026-01102
- **Main contractor:** Emerald Line Construction LLC (CN-2318841)
- **Consultant:** Dar Al Sahel Consulting Engineers

| No. | Code and finding | Article | Severity | Due | Penalty |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | D07 — Open excavation without barriers: Open foundation trenches without barriers | Art. 17.4 | Critical | 19 September 2026 at 13:10 | AED 10,000 |
| 2 | D11 — Unsafe material stacking: Bricks and spoil stacked at trench edges | Art. 21.4 | Major | 23 September 2026 at 23:59 | AED 5,000 |

**Total penalties:** AED 15,000

### Required corrective actions
1. **D07** — Excavations deeper than 1.2 m shall be shored, battered or benched; edges shall be protected by rigid barriers set at least 1 m back from the edge; spoil and materials kept at least 1 m from the edge; safe access by ladder or ramp provided.
2. **D11** — Materials shall be stacked on firm level ground, stable and interlocked, no higher than 2 m (or 3 times the base width), kept at least 1 m from slab edges and excavations, and secured against wind.

Issued under the authority of the Director, Field Operations & Inspection — Eng. Hamad Juma Al Kaabi. Authorised inspector: Reem Salem Al Marzooqi (FOI-AI-0231). The Arabic text prevails.

**Marsa Al Noor Development Authority — Field Operations & Inspection Department**

- **Main contractor:** Saqr Al Noor Contracting LLC (CN-2054417)
- **Consultant:** Al Noor Engineering Consultancy

| No. | Code and finding | Article | Severity | Due | Penalty |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | D03 — Unsafe scaffolding: Pole scaffold without boarding or guardrails | Art. 15.2 | Critical | 6 October 2026 at 14:15 | AED 10,000 |
| 2 | D09 — Unsafe ladder use: Ladder resting on a cross-pole, not secured | Art. 16.3 | Major | 8 October 2026 at 23:59 | AED 5,000 |

**Total penalties:** AED 15,000

### Required corrective actions
1. **D03** — Scaffolds shall be erected by competent persons, fully boarded at working lifts, fitted with guardrails and toe boards, braced and tied to the structure, set on base plates and sole boards, and carry a valid scaffold inspection tag (green) renewed every 7 days.
2. **D09** — Ladders shall be industrial grade, undamaged, set at about 75° (1:4), secured top or bottom, extend 1 m above the landing, and used for access or short-duration light work only, maintaining three points of contact.

Issued under the authority of the Director, Field Operations & Inspection — Eng. Hamad Juma Al Kaabi. Authorised inspector: Reem Salem Al Marzooqi (FOI-AI-0231). The Arabic text prevails.

| 3 | D11 — Unsafe material stacking: Rebar bundles stored at the excavation edge | Art. 21.4 | Major | 13 October 2026 at 23:59 | AED 5,000 |

**Total penalties:** AED 16,000

### Required corrective actions
1. **D07** — Excavations deeper than 1.2 m shall be shored, battered or benched; edges shall be protected by rigid barriers set at least 1 m back from the edge; spoil and materials kept at least 1 m from the edge; safe access by ladder or ramp provided.
2. **D05** — Work areas, walkways and stairs shall be kept free of debris, offcuts, packaging and waste; waste shall be removed to designated skips at least daily.
3. **D11** — Materials shall be stacked on firm level ground, stable and interlocked, no higher than 2 m (or 3 times the base width), kept at least 1 m from slab edges and excavations, and secured against wind.

Issued under the authority of the Director, Field Operations & Inspection — Eng. Hamad Juma Al Kaabi. Authorised inspector: Sanjay Nair (FOI-AI-0142). The Arabic text prevails.

1. **D07** — يجب تدعيم الحفريات التي يزيد عمقها على 1.2 متر أو تشكيل جوانبها بميول أو مدرجات، وحماية حوافها بحواجز صلبة على بعد متر واحد على الأقل من الحافة، وإبعاد ناتج الحفر والمواد مسافة متر على الأقل، وتوفير وصول آمن بسلم أو منحدر.
2. **D05** — يجب إبقاء مناطق العمل والممرات والسلالم خالية من المخلفات والقصاصات ومواد التغليف، ونقل النفايات إلى الحاويات المخصصة يومياً على الأقل.
3. **D11** — يجب تكديس المواد على أرض ثابتة ومستوية بشكل متماسك ومتداخل، وبارتفاع لا يتجاوز 2 متر (أو ثلاثة أضعاف عرض القاعدة)، وعلى بعد متر واحد على الأقل من حواف البلاطات والحفريات، ومؤمّنة ضد الرياح.
